title: NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own) — Backdating Window for Replacement Cancellations
content:
**Backdating window — Replaced by Private Flood requests under NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)**

For a request signed under Replaced by Private Flood because a Tidemark HomeFlood policy recorded as replacing this policy took effect, the backdating window is measured from the replacing policy's effective date to the signing date and is 120 days when no flood loss with a date of loss in the last 12 months has been reported on this policy; 30 days when such a loss was reported and the most recent of them has a payment or a denial on record; and no days when the most recent of them has neither. When the replacing policy took effect longer before the signing date than the window allows, the request may be dated no earlier than the signing date.

| Flood losses reported on this policy with a date of loss in the last 12 months | Most recent of them | Window |
|---|---|---|
| None | — | 120 days |
| One or more | Has a payment or a denial on record | 30 days |
| One or more | Has neither | No days |

*Hypothetical boundaries.* With no loss in the last 12 months, a replacing policy effective 120 days before signing is within the window and 121 days is not. With a closed loss, 30 days is within and 31 days is not.
